HMPV Virus: A Growing Concern!
Dr. Rana Chatterjee shares key tips:

1. Watch for fever, cough & respiratory issues
2. Maintain hygiene
3. Avoid close contact with infected individuals

Prevention is better than cure!
#HealthMatters
